intent: Pin that `phone_vd.sh record start|stop` (new in ~/.claude: real MP4 video of a session's own virtual display via a read-only scrcpy) passes the phone_guard PreToolUse hook as a lease-free read, while the adb input that drives the recorded app still takes that app's lease.
scope: Non-goal: changing phone_guard classification -- the hook only inspects commands containing 'adb', so `phone_vd.sh record` never reached it and needed no change
changes: TestLeases.test_recording_own_display_is_a_read: record start/stop take no lease and are not blocked; `phone_vd.sh record start a.mp4 && adb shell input -d 9 swipe ...` on the session's own display takes exactly pkg:<its app>

verification.evidence: 68 passed; every python_pkg/phone_guard module 100% statements and branches

verification.command: phone_vd.sh record start ~/data/claude-scratch/phone-record/vd37_final.mp4; 5 x adb shell input -d 37 swipe; phone_vd.sh record stop (Pixel 6a 23181JEGR08034, VD 37 running com.android.settings)
verification.evidence: ffprobe: h264 1080x2400, duration 10.511 s, 307 frames (~29 fps avg, ~35 fps while scrolling); the hook let every call through (the unit test pins that the swipe maps to pkg:<own app>; not observed live)

risks: A raw `scrcpy --display-id=<other VD>` still bypasses the guard (no 'adb' in the command); phone_vd.sh only ever records the caller's own display
rollback: git revert this commit; it only adds a test and this evidence file
